description: Maps file-path globs to logical subsystem names for the Lost Monster monorepo. Powers scripts/forensic-log.ts. Order matters: first match wins, so specific subsystems are listed before general ones.

subsystems.name: portfolio
subsystems.owns: Portfolio intelligence: the /portfolio skill and the .ai/portfolio knowledge base (per-venture OVERVIEWs + INDEX + CHANGELOG).
riskSurface: SCAN stamp drift (stale head sha = missed re-scan)
Investor-grade venture claims going stale against fast-moving repos
Read-only contract on /Volumes/Projects (must never write to sibling repos)

subsystems.name: firm-framework
subsystems.owns: The Firm worker playbooks + protocol and The Stack skills. Synced via /sync, pushed via /firm and /stack.
riskSurface: Onboarding leakage to upstream (project-specific context bleed into thefirm/thestack)

subsystems.name: labs
subsystems.owns: Labs showcase section: beta product pages under /labs, driven by lib/labs.ts.
riskSurface: labProducts array out of sync with page folders
iconMap missing a product's Lucide icon

subsystems.name: website
subsystems.owns: The Lost Monster marketing site: Next.js app router, components, content (project briefs + case studies).
riskSurface: Project briefs in website/projects/ drifting from venture repo reality
Dynamic [slug] routes for case studies / services
Light-bg content pages vs dark Bold Personal Brand homepage

subsystems.name: universal-framework
subsystems.owns: The universal development framework: templates, agents, docs, setup scripts.
riskSurface: Template drift from current Firm/Stack versions

subsystems.name: design-system
subsystems.owns: Lost Monster design system: brand docs and the living /design page.
riskSurface: Design guide vs actual component token divergence

subsystems.name: infra
subsystems.owns: Repo tooling: forensic logging, subsystem lint, harness settings.
riskSurface: Forensic generator needs tsx (not installed at repo root)
